title: Lunelle
concept: Lunelle is a maternity collection based on functionality and empowerment, designed for the contemporary woman balancing work, life and motherhood. My collection was inspired by the timeless beauty of the moon, the protection of Artemis: the Greek goddess of childbirth, mother and child sculptures of Henry Moore and the curves of the pregnant body. The stretch marks of her body are compared to the craters of the moon, which are considered symbols of imperfect beauty. Lunelle is a tribute to all the unstoppable mothers!
